basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Narayanpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 7 Accountant, Assistant Programmer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Zila Panchayat Narayanpur has notified 7 vacancies for Computer Programmer, Programme Officer, Assistant Programmer, and Accountant posts under a contract engagement. Candidates must apply offline by downloading the prescribed format, attaching self-attested copies of required certificates and mark sheets, and sending the completed form by Registered Post or Speed Post to Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Narayanpur, District- Narayanpur (Chhattisgarh) on or before 3 November 2026. Eligibility qualifications vary by post, and the consolidated pay is 51780.00 for Computer Programmer, 3987

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Narayanpur Computer Programmer at a Glance

rows.details: Computer Programmer, Programme Officer, Assistant Programmer, Accountant

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent in a closed envelope superscribed with the name of the post applied for, sent via Registered Post or Speed Post to: Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Narayanpur, District- Narayanpur (Chhattisgarh) Personal submissions by hand will not be accepted. The application must reach the office on or before 03 November 2026 by 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Computer Programmer: First-class B.E. Computer Science / MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science) / B.E. (IT) / Data Net Technology / Java / M.S.W. / Oracle knowledge preferred. Weightage given to academic percentages and practical computer test. Programme Officer: First-class M.B.A. / B.E. / MRTM (Master of Rural Technology and Management) / Graduation in Mathematics / Physics. Assistant Programmer: Recognized university degree in M.Sc. (Computer Science / IT) or MCA or equivalent, or B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science / IT or equivalent. Minimum 60% marks in computer practical test required. Accountant: 55% marks in B.Com. (relaxation for SC/ST to 50% in B.Com., and for Bastar and Narayanpur division second class in B.Com. is eligible). Minimum age is 21 years and maximum is 35 years as of 01 January 2026. Age relaxations apply to Chhattisgarh residents and various categories as per General Administration Department norms. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets. Permanent caste certificate issued by a competent authority along with a caste verification affidavit. Divyang (Disability) certificate issued by a Medical Board, if applicable. Chhattisgarh domicile certificate. Experience certificates from government rural development schemes, if applicable. No Objection Certificate from employer if working in semi-government or government institutions.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit derived from educational qualification marks, experience, and a computer skill test. For Accountant, higher secondary and graduation marks along with computer practical test weightage apply. A ratio of 1 to 10 candidates will be called for the skill test based on merit.

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment for a permanent or contract position?
faq.answer: This is a contract engagement initially for a period of up to three years, subject to performance and mutual agreement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form by Registered or Speed Post is 03 November 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxations apply to Chhattisgarh domicile residents and various categories as per the guidelines issued by the General Administration Department from time to time.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit calculated from academic marks, experience, and performance in a computer skill test.

faq.question: Q5. Can applications be submitted by hand at the office?
faq.answer: No, personal submissions directly by hand will not be accepted; applications must be sent strictly via Registered Post or Speed Post.
